sources.title: Tamagotchi Paradise Growth Chart: Evolution Guide
sources.snippet:
Tamagotchi Paradise is a fun entry into the Tamagotchi line of devices. Your Paradise shell can be connected with other players’ shells to visit, gift, and breed Tamas. We’ll show you exactly how to evolve your Tama from an egg to a Babymarutchi, then go through the Kid, Young, and Adult stages. Which Tama will you create?

## Tamagotchi Paradise Growth Chart

 Download Image

 Download Image [...] The Baby stage typically lasts between 1 and 4 hours.
    When you first start playing Tamagotchi Paradise, you’ll only have access to the field that matches your shell (or device color). Pink is Land, Blue is Water, and Purple is Sky. You’ll unlock a second field at Planet Level 4 and the third field at Planet Level 6.(#_note-2) X Research source
    If you have a Jade Forest device, your fields are Forest, Land, and Water. (Don’t worry, we have the Forest growth chart, too.) [...] How to
